---
title: "Configuration errors"
format: html
filters:
  - git-sandbox
---

Every block below is wrong on purpose. Each should render a visible
configuration error rather than a broken exercise or a blank space.

## Unknown option

```git-sandbox
title: Typo in an option name
tittle: this key does not exist
tasks:
  - text: Make a commit
    when: commits >= 1
```

## A task with no condition

```git-sandbox
title: Task missing when
tasks:
  - text: Make a commit
```

## A task with both when and js

```git-sandbox
title: Task with both
tasks:
  - text: Make a commit
    when: commits >= 1
    js: c.graph.commits.length >= 1
```

## An unknown option inside a task

```git-sandbox
title: Unknown task option
tasks:
  - text: Make a commit
    whn: commits >= 1
```

## Tasks that are not a list

```git-sandbox
title: Tasks not a list
tasks: commits >= 1
```

## Options that are not key/value at all

```git-sandbox
this is not yaml at all
```

## Two exercises sharing an id

```git-sandbox
id: duplicated
title: First
tasks:
  - text: Make a commit
    when: commits >= 1
```

```git-sandbox
id: duplicated
title: Second
tasks:
  - text: Make a commit
    when: commits >= 1
```
